scope: Reviewed exact beta collision repair required to build the shared-directive migration. Activation belongs only to module-owned Sites_cmdletConfigurations.cs after the normal shared API merge.
policy: Additive route selection preserves every listed operation, existing curated suppressions, published per-command defaults and exact request URLs. No first-URI-only metadata row is an API-completeness/absence assertion.
defaultProof: All 84 defaults uniquely proven Direct by pinned Learn Default syntax at MicrosoftDocs/microsoftgraph-docs-powershell commit 07b0cf8f6305213f3c3830c301fca69a3e82ed17 and actual same-profile method/path-ID contracts. Sixty lossy first-URI metadata family candidates disagree and are not default evidence.
dispatchPolicy: 78 ordinary mandatory-ID-discriminated groups require no new policy flags. Only six Child GET groups have identical DirectGet/NestedList mandatory IDs and require an explicit Route selector with reviewed asymmetric/explicit/published-inference opt-ins. All 24 collection/item pairs must satisfy Naming.IsListItemPair.
